sources.rights: Discovery only unless item rights verified

verified_notes: IslamHouse Russian exposes separate categories for books, articles, fatwas, audio, video and selected links; its Russian area is an active discovery source.
HadeethEnc has a Russian section with nine downloadable PDF parts and explicitly states conditions for downloading and republishing translations.
Asar Forum is an active Russian-language Islamic forum with hadith/athar and book-related discussions; treat it as discovery/provenance, not an automatic redistribution source.
Darul Fikr is a Russian Islamic publisher with a catalogue of Islamic books; publisher rights must be preserved.

The user-provided URLs minhadj.com, alhadis.ru, sunnaportal.com, asar-forum.com, toislam.ws, islamqa.info/ru, islamhouse.com/ru, mainalquran.islam.gov.qa and islam.gov.qa/droos/list.html are preserved verbatim as requested; entries whose live ownership/reuse terms were not independently confirmed remain marked VERIFY.
required_behavior: Do not delete or replace previously saved sources when new sources are found.
Search these saved sources before generic Russian-language web discovery.
Treat Russian-language sources as a distinct search lane, not merely a translation layer.
Preserve provenance and item-level rights for every acquired book or document.
